credits: (IGCS / raptoravis UUU 4.11.5 catalog: 9 per-game keys, 4 of them are camera writes)
notes: FF7 Rebirth has 4 per-game camera-write AOB keys (CAMERA_WRITE1..4) plus 5 PP/HUD/lens hooks. Camera intercept primary = AOB_FF7REBIRTH_CAMERA_WRITE1_KEY (writes Location to [rdi]). Shared UE4 pool AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 added as fallback. Pattern 1 has a wildcarded disp32 -> wildcard only.

intercepts.name: camera_write_ff7r_1
intercepts.description: Per-game AOB_FF7REBIRTH_CAMERA_WRITE1_KEY: 89 07 mov[rdi], eax + 2 vmovss to [rdi+4]/[rdi+8] -- Location X/Y/Z stores.

intercepts.name: camera_write_ff7r_2
intercepts.description: Per-game AOB_FF7REBIRTH_CAMERA_WRITE2_KEY: vmovss [rdi+0xC] + mov [rdi+0x14] -- Rotation block writes.

intercepts.name: camera_write_ff7r_4
intercepts.description: Per-game AOB_FF7REBIRTH_CAMERA_WRITE4_KEY: 3 mov writes to [rbx+0x28/30/3C] reading from [rdi+disp32] -- alt camera struct path.

intercepts.name: camera_struct_intercept_ue4_sse_fallback
intercepts.description: Shared UE4 pool AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 (SSE v0) -- only matches if the per-game patterns above miss.

capture._capture_note: UE4 reversed-Z. Open-world cinematics with deep horizon -> log curve.

camera_write_profile._comment: Per-game CAMERA_WRITE1 uses rdi as camera struct base with float Location at 0x00/0x04/0x08; rotation/FOV offsets need verification via __cam_intercept_capture before enabling trajectory playback.
